fixed_selection: For each of SYNTH/YCB TRAIN/VALIDATION, select first/middle/last id in lexicographic target-id order from sealed public source GLOBAL_INPUTS;12 targets, no score-based selection.
scope: Read newly implemented inference code and call its pure input_features/context/initialbox/queryvalid helpers on public source inputs only. No current/private RGB, GT or scores before output seal. No GPU, optimizer, training, thresholds or PnP.
CPU_SAM: Replay unchanged frozen source SAM on the12 public targets using CPU to obtain selected full-resolution logit. Maximum predicted quality, first tie, same rough box. These replayed logits may differ numerically from stored GPU logits.
parity: Separate exact recipe parity on the SAME CPU full logit from CPU-versus-stored-GPU SAM drift. RGB/native75/box/grid/mapping/context must match saved source arrays. SAM same-logit recipe must match independently reconstructed normalized float16 features; report stored GPU max errors and foreground flips without threshold changes.
context: Compute valid-channel weighted mean64 over all8 stored half P3 ROIs, including corners omitted from label rows. SYNTH uses authorized source-only v60 SYNTH_ROI_CACHE; YCB source rows contain all8.
initialbox: SYNTH source box should match input-only finite N0q8 minmax; YCB source box is annotation-derived jitter and is passed explicitly for feature parity rather than mislabeled as N0-derived.
preserve: No root inference/model/cache changes. New public fixture artifacts only in source_audit/INFERENCE_FIXTURE. Source model freeze and thresholds remain unchanged.
